what_it_does: INSIGHT replaces slow circuit simulation (SPICE, which solves physics equations step-by-step) with a fast neural surrogate model—a transformer network trained to predict circuit behavior. Rather than solving differential equations for hours, the neural model predicts performance in milliseconds. The key innovation: it learns to predict performance as an autoregressive sequence (one output building on the previous), achieving both high accuracy and data efficiency. A transfer-learning technique (LoRA) lets one trained model adapt to new manufacturing processes with 60% less data, cutting training time by 25%.
